metadata.name: json_twin
metadata.description: Same cases as the YAML suites, run against the JSON twin of the saas policy (saas.json) and written as a JSON suite, to prove both formats behave identically.

cases.name: filtered select allowed
cases.sql: SELECT id, status FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 10

cases.name: join report allowed
cases.sql: SELECT c.name, count(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = $1 WHERE o.tenant_id = $1 GROUP BY c.name LIMIT 20

cases.name: global table allowed
cases.sql: SELECT code, symbol FROM currencies LIMIT 10

cases.name: pii column
cases.sql: SELECT email FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 10

cases.name: star expands to pii
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 10

cases.name: table not in policy
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM api_keys WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 10

cases.name: limit too high
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 1001

cases.name: pg_sleep
cases.sql: SELECT pg_sleep(5) FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 1

cases.name: smuggled statement
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 1; DELETE FROM orders
